items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: I was playing up there when I left to go to Chicago. Guidry and Allen.

ctx.x: Well, what you call them, is that? There's a ballroom on the corner, and upstairs used to be a little club, nightclub. I was playing up there when I left to go to Chicago. Guidry and Allen. Oh. Guidry and Allen.
Fess has told me about that. Hoss told me about that.
